import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyDegreeComparison
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyTwistedKernel
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.SectionsLifting

/-!
# Uniform vanishing for intrinsic twists of divisor families

The quotient stalks of a degree-`d` field-test divisor family determine an
effective Weil divisor of degree `d`. Its actual quotient twisted by `O(A)`
has kernel `O(A-D)`, so the uniform divisor-module vanishing bound applies
when `deg(A) - d` is large enough. The bound is chosen before the extension
field and does not require the extension to be algebraically closed.

Vanishing lifts global sections through the twisted Cartier quotient. This
supplies the fieldwise section-surjectivity input to the divisor
Grassmannian construction; identifying `O(A)` with the pullback of a fixed
twist and assembling relative base change remain separate obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
  (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]

/-- One bound, chosen before the extension field and the degree, makes the
actual intrinsically twisted Cartier kernel acyclic in degree one. -/
theorem exists_uniform_bound_hModule_one_divisorTwistKernel :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ],
      letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
      letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
          ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
      ∀ (x : DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))))
        (A : (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor) {d : ℕ},
        x.HasFiberDeg d → b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg κ A - (d : ℤ) →
        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
          (toModuleKSheafOfModules (baseChangeField C κ)
            (kernel ((Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules κ A)).inv ≫
              Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules κ A))
                (normalizedQuotient x)))) 1) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_uniform_bound_hModule_one_divisorModules k C
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro κ _ _
  letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro x A d hx hA
  have hAD : b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg κ
      (A - (show (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CurveDivisor.deg_add, CurveDivisor.deg_neg,
      show CurveDivisor.deg κ
          (show (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor from x.effectiveWeilDivisor) =
        (d : ℤ) by
          simpa [baseChangeField] using
            (x.deg_effectiveWeilDivisor_eq_of_hasFiberDeg hx)]
    exact hA
  let e := (toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor (baseChangeField C κ)).mapIso
    (divisorTwistKernelIso x A)
  exact (Equiv.subsingleton_congr (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv e 1).toEquiv).mpr
    (hb κ _ hAD)

/-- The intrinsic Cartier quotient is surjective on global sections at a
single bound independent of the extension field and the family degree. -/
theorem exists_uniform_bound_divisorTwistQuotient_sections_surjective :
    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [Algebra k κ],
      letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
      letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
          ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
        inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
      ∀ (x : DivFamily C.hom
          (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k κ)))))
        (A : (baseChangeField C κ).left.CurveDivisor) {d : ℕ},
        x.HasFiberDeg d → b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg κ A - (d : ℤ) →
        Function.Surjective
          (((Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules κ A)).inv ≫
            Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules κ A))
              (normalizedQuotient x)).app ⊤).hom := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_uniform_bound_hModule_one_divisorTwistKernel C
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro κ _ _
  letI : (baseChangeField C κ).left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    .ofHom (baseChangeField C κ).hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      ((baseChangeField C κ).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (baseChangeField C κ).hom)
  intro x A d hx hA
  let q := (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules κ A)).inv ≫
    Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules κ A)) (normalizedQuotient x)
  letI : Epi x.q := x.epi
  letI : Epi (normalizedQuotient x) := by
    dsimp [normalizedQuotient]
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi (Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules κ A))
      (normalizedQuotient x)) := Modules.tensorObj_functoriality_epi_right _
  letI : Epi q := inferInstance
  letI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
      (toModuleKSheafOfModules (baseChangeField C κ) (kernel q)) 1) :=
    hb κ x A hx hA
  simpa [q] using
    (sections_surjective_of_kernel_hModule_one_subsingleton
      (baseChangeField C κ) q)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
